title: What Harara is
text: Harara is a decision-support prototype for planning outdoor work in Gulf heat. It reads the hourly weather forecast for a site, computes WBGT, and lays out an hour-by-hour work and rest plan for a crew that delivers the required work-hours while holding down the heat the crew carries, within Qatar Ministerial Decision 17/2021. Every number it shows comes from the forecast, the physics, or a cited rule, never from the language model. It answers questions about heat, WBGT, the forecast, and outdoor-work rules, and it plans a shift. It does nothing else.
